title: Alaska Airlines earns top award for innovative multi-brand digital experience
summary: Alaska’s Digital Experience team earned the 2026 Contentstack Experience Award for World’s Best Digital Experience for creating a shared digital foundation that powers Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines, Atmos Rewards and Atmos for Business while preserving each brand’s distinct identity.
body_markdown:
The effort marked a first for any U.S. airline’s digital experience: a shared technology foundation that can serve multiple brands while preserving the identity of each. Rather than building separate systems for Alaska and Hawaiian, Alaska’s Digital Experience team created a brand-aware platform that automatically delivers the appropriate colors, styling, links and content based on the brand experience a guest is visiting. More than two dozen product engineering teams use these dynamic, shared components on Alaska’s new platform, while content across the two websites,[alaskaair.com](https://www.alaskaair.com/) and[hawaiianairlines.com](https://www.hawaiianairlines.com/) , is now available in 10 languages.


Alaska’s award-winning work makes it easier for its teams to build, update and translate digital experiences, creating a flexible foundation that can evolve as the combined company expands its global network.


The recognition also reflects a broader commitment to continually improve every part of the guest journey. From digital tools that make planning and managing travel easier to[enhancements at the airport and onboard](https://news.alaskaair.com/guest-experience/alaska-airlines-and-hawaiian-airlines-unveil-aurora-and-leihoku/) , Alaska’s investments are designed to make every guest touchpoint more seamless, thoughtful and rooted in care.
